title: chore(objectui): move the console pin to 1f23d5b070fa, carrying objectstack-ai/objectui#12475 and objectstack-ai/objectui#12493
body:
Fixes #23691
Clause-②: no

This PR moves the console pin from `b9814b334d8a` to `1f23d5b070fa`, objectui `main` at `1f23d5b070fa4d0cee0274902944d247bc4588b7`. That commit carries both objectui changes the card owes:

- `720f6d4` (objectstack-ai/objectui#12475, objectui PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12495): Setup's catalog item editors show History and Audit only to a caller the narrowed trail doors admit. This is ruling `6190477105` item 3, the maintainer's A1 on #23546.
- `b512428` (objectstack-ai/objectui#12493, objectui PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12536): the AI build page no longer reads `?handoffPrompt=` from the URL, so a link can no longer send a message to the build agent on the signed-in user's behalf. The triage comment `6196301086` widened the card to carry it.

It is one bump, through `scripts/bump-objectui.sh`, and not a rider on another PR.

**Tier:** no governed surface. `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --branch claude/issue-23691-console-pin-hop` reads 0 of 5 paths on the register. Size: 5 files, +141 / −10 (151 changed lines, under the 3000 human-merge line).

## The hop: 83 objectui commits, 300 paths, all on objectui `main`

- REST `compare` `b9814b334d8a...1f23d5b070fa`: `ahead_by` 83, `behind_by` 0, 300 files.
- In the sibling checkout (deepened with `git fetch --unshallow` first), `git merge-base --is-ancestor` exits 0 for `720f6d4`, for `b512428` and for the old pin, each against `1f23d5b070fa`. It also exits 0 for `1f23d5b070fa` against objectui `origin/main`. `720f6d4` is 12 commits behind the new pin and `b512428` is 2 behind. Control: the objectui tip `b5416943ce45` against the old pin exits 1.
- **Why `1f23d5b070fa` and not the tip.** When the work started, objectui `main` had moved two commits past the commit the dispatch read, to `b5416943ce45`, and that tip's push-run CI was still in progress. At `1f23d5b070fa` every check-run of objectui's required set (`Lint`, `Type Check`, `Test (shard N/16)`, `Build & E2E`, `Build Docs`, `Changeset Declaration`) reads `completed: success`, 41 of 41 across its merge-queue and push runs, re-read at 2026-10-15T17:43Z. At that reading the tip had one cancelled required run (`Lint`), and `main` had moved again, to `518a8e308466`. `1f23d5b070fa` is the newest `main` commit read fully green that carries both fixes.

## Acceptance readings, at the new pin

### (a) The built console's AI build page never sends `?handoffPrompt=` on load

**Source, at objectui `1f23d5b070fa`.** `packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx` reads the Builder handoff only from navigation state: `readBuilderHandoffState(location.state)`. The prompt is seeded once per history entry, and the entry's state is replaced without `handoffPrompt`, so a reload does not send it again. `git grep` for a `searchParams` read of `handoffPrompt` (`get('handoffPrompt')`) finds nothing under `packages` or `apps` at the new pin. The same search at the old pin finds the read, at `AiChatPage.tsx:882`.

**The pin test**, `packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/__tests__/AiChatPage.handoffNeverFromUrl-12493.test.tsx` (objectui PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12536), asserts four things:
- a page loaded with `?handoffPrompt=` sends nothing (`sent` stays `[]`);
- the in-app "Open in Builder" handoff lands its text once, by navigation state, and the URL never carries it;
- a reload of the handoff history entry does not send it again;
- control: a user-typed first message sends.

**Built bundle.** `scripts/build-console.sh` built objectui at the pin into `.cache/objectui-1f23d5b070fa/`. The AI build page lands in `apps/console/dist/assets/ObjectView-CPn8lYVn.js` (198569 bytes), the only asset that names `handoffPrompt`. The minifier writes string literals as template literals, so the pattern accepts all three quote characters. The results:
- a `.get(…handoffPrompt…)` call: 0 hits in that asset and 0 in all 3434 assets;
- positive control, `.get(…package…)`: 1 hit in the same asset. It is the same component's `?package=` read, the line just before the old `handoffPrompt` read. Here it is followed by the navigation-state reader: `` h=d.get(`package`)?.trim()||void 0,g=o(),_=(0,$.useMemo)(()=>Uc(g.state),[g.state]) ``.

The copy in `packages/console/dist/assets/` is byte-identical (`cmp` exit 0). On a smoke boot (below), the served `/_console/assets/ObjectView-CPn8lYVn.js` is byte-identical to it and gives the same 0 and 1.

### (b) History and Audit are hidden for a `setup.access`-only caller

**Source, at objectui `1f23d5b070fa`.**
- `packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useCanAuthorMetadata.ts` declares `AUTHORING_TRAIL_CAPABILITIES = ['studio.access', 'manage_metadata']`. `useCanReadAuthoringTrail()` answers whether the caller holds any of them, and fails open when no capability set was reported.
- `ResourceEditPage.tsx` calls it once (`const canReadTrail = useCanReadAuthoringTrail()`, line 1210). It gates the History and Audit entries (`!createMode && canReadTrail`, lines 2322, 2334, 3251 and 3286), and a `?tab=history` / `?tab=audit` deep link (line 1228).
- `PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx` calls it at line 476. It gates the History button and the embedded History sheet (lines 1560, 1624 and 1787). That editor offers no Audit entry.

**The pin test**, `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/trailDoorsGate-12475.test.tsx`, asserts:
- a `setup.access`-only caller sees neither `history-button` nor `audit-button` on `ResourceEditPage`, and no History on `PermissionMatrixEditor`, routed or embedded;
- a `studio.access` or a `manage_metadata` holder sees them;
- an unreported capability set fails open;
- control: create mode shows no trail entries at all.

**Built bundle.** `useCanAuthorMetadata-B_1yXw8l.js` carries the gate: `` var r=[`studio.access`,t];function i(){let{hasCapabilities:t}=e();return r.some(e=>t([e]))} ``, exported as `n`. `metadata-admin-GnoOznL8.js` imports that `n` as `ht` and calls `Sn=ht()`. Both `` "data-testid":`audit-button` `` and `` "data-testid":`history-button` `` sit behind `!n&&Sn&&`.

**No live browser run.** This is a source and bundle reading only. A `setup.access`-only organization admin is not a seeded identity, so a browser pass would first have to provision one.

## Artefacts that travel with the pin

- **Console changeset** `.changeset/console-1f23d5b070fa.md`, from `scripts/bump-objectui.sh 1f23d5b070fa… --no-commit`.
  - `@objectstack/console` **major**, the level the script derived. It is objectui's own declared `major` (objectstack-ai/objectui#12334, the sync major that tracks `@objectstack/*` 18).
  - The range holds 76 releasing entries, 4 release-nothing changesets and 3 commits with no changeset, listed by subject.
  - The major is safe in this pre window. `.changeset/pre.json` is pre mode on `next`, and `check-changeset-no-major` stands aside there. The `18.0.0-next.1` cut (`0c52e4307`) also consumed two `major` changesets and still moved `18.0.0-next.0` → `18.0.0-next.1`.
  - The script's ADR-0087 placeholder is answered `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. Each of the five declared-breaking entries is answered against this tree: objectstack-ai/objectui#12334, objectstack-ai/objectui#12464 (page kind `jsx`), objectstack-ai/objectui#12461 (`topbar.switchObject`), objectstack-ai/objectui#12055 (upload `scope`) and objectstack-ai/objectui#12325 (view `provider: 'api'`). `Clause-②: no` is in the changeset.
- **SDUI manifest.** `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs` over `.cache/objectui-1f23d5b070fa/apps/console` wrote 107 components (sha256 `370153544e9b…`) and re-recorded `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` at the pin.
  - No component was added or removed.
  - `record:related_list` gains the `parentDataSource` input (objectstack-ai/objectui#12294).
  - The `object-grid` and `object-map` `data` descriptions drop the retired `provider: 'api'` arm (objectstack-ai/objectui#12325).
- **Lockstep record.** `pnpm gen:sdui-lockstep` re-records `packages/sdui-parser/objectui-lockstep.json` at `1f23d5b070fa`. It ran with `OBJECTUI_ROOT` set to the pin's build worktree, so the shared objectui checkout's HEAD was never moved. Across the hop, objectui's `packages/sdui-parser` changed only in `package.json`. The grammar blob `0131f27cf86d` and the predicate blob `76c18fb95d1f` are unchanged, and `check:sdui-lockstep` passes (214 grammar lines, 25 codes, the predicate). **No parser port is owed.**
- **No pin-citation re-measure, and no pin-citation changeset.** `check:objectui-pin-citations` retired on `main` in `1418de4c7`, under ruling C on #23434: read points are dated ledger readings, and "a pin hop then moves nothing". So no `packages/spec/src/**` hunk is in this PR.

## Console Pin Gate steps, run locally (each exited 0)

1. Client closure: `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/client --filter=@objectstack/sdui-parser` (34 tasks).
2. `scripts/build-console.sh` at the new pin. It reported:
   - bundle canary `import/jobs` present;
   - exactly one zod version literal (`{major:4,minor:6,patch:5}`);
   - "Console bundle carries THIS tree's @objectstack/spec, and only it";
   - dist ready, 64460 KB, from objectui@1f23d5b070fa.

   That run came before the manifest regeneration, so its dist ships the previous tracked manifest. The dist is gitignored, and CI and the release build their own.
3. `pnpm check:console-sha` and `pnpm check:console-injection`: both exit 0, inside the gate run below.

**Smoke boot.** `pnpm dev -- --fresh -p 43198` from this worktree:
- `GET /api/v1/health` answered 200 (`status: ok`, version `18.0.0-next.1`).
- `GET /_console/` answered 200 (18552 bytes), and its entry `assets/index-zcLuSSpu.js` answered 200.
- The served `/_console/.objectui-sha` reads `1f23d5b070fa4d0cee0274902944d247bc4588b7`.

I stopped the server by its listening PID and the recorded `pnpm` PID, and the port was free afterwards.

## Verification, at `7ab227d26`

- **Tests that read the changed artefacts.**
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/sdui-parser exec vitest run`: 14 files, 225 passed.
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/validate-jsx-pages.production-witness.test.ts`: 5 passed. It feeds the real repo-root `sdui.manifest.json` to the validator.
  - The `packages/cli` tests that read a console dist manifest are left to CI. This diff changes no package source.
- **Derived gates.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths, from the merge base) derived 69 commands. Each was run with its exit code recorded. `--ran` reports "69 derived, 69 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN".
  - Two first exited 3 (prerequisite not met) and were re-run green at the same head. `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needed its fixture commit `621a48760788`, fetched at depth 1 (48 cases). `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` needed a full `turbo run build --filter=!@objectstack/docs` (75 tasks); it then read 110 entry points across 68 packages.
  - Named here: `check-sdui-manifest` (sha256 `370153544e9b…`, 107 components, recorded at the live pin), its self-test (13 cases), `check:sdui-lockstep`, `check:objectui-changeset`, `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`, `check-changeset-no-major --base origin/main` (pre mode) and `check-empty-changeset --base origin/main`.
- **NOT MEASURED: repo-wide `pnpm lint` and the `Type Check` lanes.** Reason: both are CI-owned runs, and this diff adds no TypeScript.

## Acceptance notes

- **Liveness verdicts this hop makes stale. They are not changed here, and the next spec PR owes them.** At `1f23d5b070fa` the shipped console reads three things the spec and its ledger still call unread:
  - **`page.print`.** `packages/spec/liveness/page.json` carries `print` and its 12 children as `planned`, and `print` has `authorWarn` with an `authorHint`. `PagePrintSchema`'s docblock and eight describes say "until it ships, nothing applies it". objectui `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/page-print.ts#buildPagePrintStylesheet` now applies all eight keys (objectstack-ai/objectui#11958).
    - Measured on this branch: `lintLivenessProperties` from `@objectstack/lint`, on a page declaring `print`, emits `liveness-planned-property` with the hint "…no renderer applies the paper, margins, running header and footer or page numbers yet — printing the page today prints the screen layout".
    - `packages/lint/src/lint-liveness-properties.test.ts` uses `page.print` as its planned-with-`authorWarn` control, so that control has to move with the flip.
  - **`record:related_list.parentDataSource`.** Its describe opens with `[PLANNED — not yet rendered]`, and its docblock says the marker leaves "when that leg lands". `liveness/page.json`'s `_note` carries the same reading, and case E of `component-record-related-list-parent-23134.test.ts` pins the marker. objectui `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-related-list.tsx` now reads the key (objectstack-ai/objectui#12294), and the regenerated manifest lists it as a renderer input.
  - **`translation.json` `flows.successMessage` and `flows.errorMessage`** are `planned`. objectui `packages/app-shell/src/utils/flowResponse.ts` now reads both through the spec's `translateFlow` (objectstack-ai/objectui#12075).
  - Flipping them edits `packages/spec/src/**`, the ledger and a lint test, and needs a contract review. The dispatch scoped this hop to the pin artefacts, and the work is reported to the seat for one follow-up card.
- objectstack-ai/objectui#12493 is not a card in this repository. This PR carries its objectui change into the shipped console and closes nothing there.
